+// Return true if the leading MemBarRelease around a CAS-like LoadStore node may
+// be elided. Its only job is to order every access preceding the CAS before the
+// CAS's store, and a store carrying the rl annotation does that on its own by
+// PPO rule 6 - the same equivalence the is_Store() branch of
+// unnecessary_release() below already relies on for a releasing store. An
+// LR/SC pair therefore qualifies here, where cas_trailing_membar_elidable()
+// above needs the stronger .aqrl on a single AMO.
+//
+// Dropping the `fence rw,w` gives up the ordering of those preceding accesses
+// against stores which *follow* the CAS, but the canonical mapping does not
+// provide that edge either: an lr.aq/sc.rl sequence "does not act as a fence
+// for ordering ordinary load and store instructions before and after the
+// sequence", per the Zalrsc chapter of the unprivileged spec. And an
+// unsuccessful SC gives rise to no memory operation at all, so the failure
+// path has no release edge to provide.
+bool cas_leading_membar_elidable(int opcode)
+{
+  assert(is_CAS(opcode, true), "expecting a compare and swap");
+
+  switch (opcode) {
+    // Matched to amoswap/amoadd.aqrl.
+    case Op_GetAndSetI:
+    case Op_GetAndSetL:
+    case Op_GetAndSetP:
+    case Op_GetAndSetN:
+    case Op_GetAndAddI:
+    case Op_GetAndAddL:
+      return true;
+    // Matched to amocas.{w|d}.aqrl with Zacas, to lr.{w|d}.aq + sc.{w|d}.rl
+    // without it. Both carry the rl annotation on their store.
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapI:
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapL:
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapP:
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapN:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeI:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeL:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeP:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeN:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapI:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapL:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapP:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapN:
+      return true;
+    // Sub-word forms reach amocas.{b|h}.aqrl only with Zabha. Otherwise they
+    // are open coded by cmpxchg_narrow_value(), whose LR/SC variant still
+    // carries lr.w.aq + sc.w.rl, but whose Zacas variant can leave through the
+    // failure path having executed nothing but a plain lw, so there the
+    // leading membar has to be kept as well.
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapB:
+    case Op_CompareAndSwapS:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeB:
+    case Op_CompareAndExchangeS:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapB:
+    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapS:
+      return !UseZacas || UseZabha;
+    default:
+      return false;
+  }
+}
+
